package.name: autosdv_cuda_preprocessor
package.description: CUDA point cloud filters for the localization preprocessing chain, filling the two gaps in Autoware's own CUDA preprocessor: a standalone crop box and a random downsample. Both read and write cuda_blackboard::CudaPointCloud2, so they chain GPU-resident with autoware_cuda_pointcloud_preprocessor's CudaVoxelGridDownsampleFilterNode between them.
